description: This file provides lightweight, dependency-free sound effects using the Web Audio API. It defines functions for initializing audio context, playing specific sound effects (move and capture sounds), and preparing the audio system (primeSfx). The code emphasizes non-blocking, fail-silent behavior to ensure smooth integration into the larger chess application.

methods.name: getAudioContext
methods.description: Initializes and returns the Web Audio API context, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: ensureRunning
methods.description: Ensures the audio context is running, attempting to resume if suspended.

methods.name: scheduleBeep
methods.description: Creates and schedules a short beep sound with specified frequency, duration, waveform type, and start time.

methods.name: playMoveSfx
methods.description: Plays a subtle move sound consisting of two ascending beeps.

methods.name: playCaptureSfx
methods.description: Plays a capture sound with a quick zap and low thud.

methods.name: primeSfx
methods.description: Attempts to initialize or resume the audio context, typically called on user gesture.
